utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Noah, what’s still left on the repair drive list?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m pretty sure I asked, but I can’t remember what’s left—what do you still need?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: We still need volunteers, plus a wrench, tape, and spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Rosa — I’ll keep spreading the word and let folks know Sunday at 10 AM at the community center, plus to bring any tools they can.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — that’s a huge help. I’ll keep organizing from my side and make sure folks know we still need volunteers, a wrench, tape, and spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Got it — I’ll keep telling folks we still need volunteers, a wrench, tape, and spare screws for Sunday at 10 AM.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Quinn — that 10 AM time should still fit around school drop-off and pickup, and I’ll let you know if I can bring anything special.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Faye — I’ll spread the word and tell folks the basics are covered, and only special tools are needed if they’ve got a specific repair in mind.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll keep it on my calendar and let you know if I can bring any special tools.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I can bring a wrench and some spare screws, and I’ll be there Sunday at 10.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, Dane — I’ve got you down for the wrench and spare screws, and Sunday at 10. If you think of anything else you can donate, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I can also bring a roll of tape if you still need it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: 10 AM at the community center still works for me. I’ll bring gloves and check for a wrench, tape, and any spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, I can bring my screwdriver set and help with whatever needs fixing. If you spot anything else we should prep for, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey—that should cover it for now. I’ll let you know if I think of anything else before 10 AM.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: What do you need me to bring or do for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Can you send me the pickup time and drop-off place? I just need the details so I can plan the parking and timing properly.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll send the pickup time and drop-off place shortly.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard folks were organizing a repair drive—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Nell — I’m keeping an eye on the repair drive supplies right now, so if you notice anything missing, let me know and I’ll handle it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure thing — I heard it’s looking for screwdrivers, screws, and old extension cords, so I’ll keep an ear out for any of those.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d start with the loose porch step and the broken outlets, and if we have time we can check the faucet too. I can send the time and meeting spot again if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That works for me — please resend the time and meeting spot, and I’ll keep the porch step and outlets at the top of the list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — I’ll resend the time and meeting spot, and thanks for keeping the porch step and outlets at the top of the list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just checking—has the pickup time and drop-off place been confirmed yet?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Not yet on my end—I’m still waiting to hear the final pickup time and drop-off spot. If I catch it while I’m out, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks—please do. I just want to make sure we’ve got the final pickup time and drop-off spot as soon as you hear it.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a hand and bring a few tools—just let me know what still needs fixing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. Just point me to what still needs doing, and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good—let’s make a quick list of what needs fixing, and I’ll bring whatever tools we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. If you can help with the repair drive, that would really mean a lot right now.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll keep spreading the word and let neighbors know when and where it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Vik. That helps a lot — I really appreciate you spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just let me know the pickup time and drop-off spot when you’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’m checking the pickup time and drop-off spot now, and I’ll send them over as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — I’ll watch for it.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: 10 AM works for me. I can bring a small toolbox and help wherever you need at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Leo—thanks! See you at 10 AM at the community center with your toolbox, and I’ll have everything else ready.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—I’ll be there at 10 with the toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just making sure—it's still on, right? What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, it’s still on. If you can, I’d love help sorting the donated tools and checking what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it—I can do that. Just send me what’s already been donated, and I’ll help sort through it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring my screwdriver set and help where it’s needed. Just let me know if there’s a specific repair I should prep for.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Rey — that’d be really helpful. I’m a bit out of the loop, but I can check if they need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, just let me know what you find out, and I’ll be ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive is at 10 AM over at the community center, and they still need volunteers plus tools like a wrench, tape, and spare screws. If I hear anything else, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks — so 10 AM at the community center, got it. I’ll keep an eye out for any updates on the volunteers and tools.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good — I’ll let you know if I hear any more about the volunteers or tools.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s awesome, Vik — thank you! The more neighbors we reach, the better chance we have of getting everything fixed up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep spreading the word and remind folks about the time, meeting spot, and any small tools they can bring.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That would be perfect, Vik — thank you. I’ll make sure everyone knows where to meet and what to bring too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still keeping tabs on the supplies for the repair drive—if you hear of anything we’re short on, let me know and I’ll count it in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’ll pass along anything I hear about. Thanks for keeping tabs on it!

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Bo — I appreciate it. I’ll keep tracking what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam — I really appreciate it. If you can help with the repair drive, I could use someone to keep things organized and let people know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I can help keep things organized and let folks know what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would be a huge help, Sam. Could you keep track of donations and remind people what items are still needed?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Dane — I’ll keep an ear out and let you know if I find anything. Around 6 sounds great.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I’ll come by around 6 with some tools and see what else needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good, Dane — I’ll keep an ear out for screwdrivers, screws, or old extension cords and let you know if I find any.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks for checking in, Nell — the repair drive is now on Sunday at the community center, and we still need volunteers and a few tools if you can help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, got it — I can spread the word and keep an ear out for any screwdrivers, screws, or old extension cords too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be wonderful, Nell — thank you. If you hear of any volunteers or extra tools, just let me know and I’ll keep everything organized.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing—just point me to what still needs doing, and I’ll help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Great—10 AM at the community center still works for me. I’ll bring gloves and check for a wrench, tape, and any spare screws.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — I’ll head over at 10 and help with whatever’s left. Just let me know if there’s anything specific you want me to grab.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — once you have the pickup time and drop-off spot, send them my way so I can plan the parking and timing.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I will — I’m just waiting on the final pickup time and drop-off spot, then I’ll send them over right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Faye — I’ll wait for the final details, then I can sort out the timing and parking.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still keeping an eye on the repair drive supplies, and I’ll let you know right away if anything’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Opal—do we still need the wrench, tape, and spare screws, or is that covered now?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still tracking those, Mina — the wrench, tape, and spare screws are still needed as far as I can tell. I’ll flag it right away if any of them get covered.
